NONE: › mainly US old-fashioned a title for an old woman
（對老年婦女的稱呼）大媽，大娘
› written abbreviation for the US state of Massachusetts: used in addresses
（美國）麻塞諸塞州，麻薩諸塞州（寫地址時Massachusetts的縮寫）

example: As my old ma used to say, you can't spend what you ain't got.
正如我老媽過去常說那樣，不能寅吃卯糧。
[ as form of address ] What's wrong, Ma?
Ma Johnson always used to bake the best cookies.
詹森大媽以前烘烤的小甜餅總是最好吃的。
文科碩士學位；文科碩士（Master of Arts的縮寫）
